episode_event_academy_2026summer_02/8301:
I noticed this with your other sygna suit,
which matches Pecharunt...
but your style is always on point, Carmine!
Heheh! You’ve got a good eye!

I think you’d look good in a jinbei! Maybe
not as good as me, but still...
Why don’t you try wearing one to a festival?

I guess I did wear a yukata to a festival in
Jubilife Village.
You in a yukata, Akari? Oh, I’d LOVE to see!

I’m not confident I can pull it off as well as
you, Carmine.
Don’t sweat it! I say wear what you want!

Wearing traditional clothes is part of what
makes festivals fun. You should try it!
I guess you’re right! Might as well, huh?
I’ll even help you pick out a jinbei!
episode_event_academy_2026summer_02/8302:
Back in Kitakami, I took photos of Juliana in
a jinbei, and now I get a photo shoot with
you, too!
I’ve still got plenty of poses!
The shutter sounds so rhythmic, like music...

You’re just as outgoing as Juliana, aren’t
you, kiddo.

it really takes me back to Kitakami and all
its scenery.

And seeing you brings back my own
memories of Kitakami!

I never thought you and I would be
classmates at the same academy!
Pasio is one surprise after another, isn’t it?

When your days are full of surprises, you get
more photo opportunities!
True! Plus, you learn new things every day!

Whether it’s as a photographer or your
classmate...

I’ll take your photo from all kinds of
perspectives!

Thanks! I’ll do my best—so you can capture
my shining moments!
episode_event_academy_2026summer_02/8303: Kris! Can you help me with my studies?

There was something from Biology I didn’t
quite get...
Sure! Happy to help if I can!
Thanks!

I love Pokémon, so I want to learn more
about them.

But we learn so many things in Biology that
I’m struggling to keep up...
Nobody knows everything from the get-go.
We have to keep learning little by little.
That’s what the academy is for!
Yeah, that’s true!

Speaking of school, I struggled a bit in my
art class.
Really? You too?

Yeah, but the teachers were all supportive,
and as I continued to sketch...

I slowly started improving, and that boosted
my confidence!
So don’t give up! Let’s keep doing our best!
Yeah!

I’m glad I’m friends with someone positive
like you, Kris, who’s always doing your best!

I can do my best because I’m surrounded by
friends like you who always give their all!

And it’s fun being at the academy because
everyone’s here!

Hehe! Let’s keep doing our best and helping
each other!
episode_event_academy_2026summer_02/8304:
Oh, sweet! This spot seems good for loafing
around.

Looks extra comfy—perfect for catching a
few z’s.
No need to get all frowny. Take it easy!

Take it easy? I don’t think I’ve seen you NOT
take it easy—even during class.
Why are you even at the academy?
Look, everyone’s got their reasons, OK?

I’m not sure I understand. I can’t think of any
other reason than to study.

You sure about that? There’s lots to learn at
the academy outside of class.
I guess you have a point.

And what were you doing? Looked to me
like you were just spacing out.

I was organizing my thoughts about what I
learned in class.

Well, I think it’s time for a nap! Let’s both do
our own thing, OK?
He’d fit right in in Alola.
